text: I've officially started my PhD program at CU Boulder! I am excited to be working at [BLAST](https://blast-cu.github.io/) and be advised by [Dr. Maria Pacheco](https://blast-cu.github.io/mlpacheco/).
Discourse Analysis via Questions and Answers: Parsing Dependency Structures of Questions Under Discussion got published in [ACL Findings](https://aclanthology.org/2023.findings-acl.710/)!
OLEA: Tool and Infrastructure for Offensive Language Error Analysis in English, a System Demo paper that I co-authored, got published at [EACL](https://aclanthology.org/2023.eacl-demo.24/)!
After 2 years, and with the unwavering support of many, wonderful humans and dogs; I've completed the graduate program in Computational Linguistics at CU Boulder!
